description: This file provides test support utilities for the browser CLI component, including functions to create command-line interface programs, manage runtime state mocks, and facilitate testing workflows related to browser command execution.

methods.name: export function createBrowserProgram(params?: { withGatewayUrl?: boolean }): { createBrowserProgram
methods.description: Creates a CLI program with a 'browser' command, optionally including a gateway URL option.

methods.name: export function getBrowserCliRuntimeCapture(): CliRuntimeCapture { getBrowserCliRuntimeCapture
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the CLI runtime capture instance used in tests.

methods.name: export function getBrowserCliRuntime() { getBrowserCliRuntime
methods.description: Returns the default runtime from the captured CLI runtime state.

methods.name: export async function mockBrowserCliDefaultRuntime() { mockBrowserCliDefaultRuntime
methods.description: Mocks and returns the default runtime for testing purposes.

methods.name: export async function runCommandWithRuntimeMock( runCommandWithRuntimeMock
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous action with a mocked runtime, handling errors via a callback.

methods.name: export async function createBrowserCliUtilsMockModule() { createBrowserCliUtilsMockModule
methods.description: Creates a mock module providing CLI utilities for testing.

methods.name: export async function createBrowserCliRuntimeMockModule() { createBrowserCliRuntimeMockModule
methods.description: Creates a mock module for the default CLI runtime used in tests.

ctags.name: browserCliRuntimeState
ctags.pattern: /^const browserCliRuntimeState = { capture: null as CliRuntimeCapture | null };$/

ctags.name: parentOpts
ctags.pattern: /^  const parentOpts = (cmd: Command) => cmd.parent?.opts?.() as BrowserParentOpts;$/
